start_dates: every trading day in Q1 of each evaluation year
end_date: last trading day of the same calendar year

factor_rules.cross_sectional_rank: pct average, float32, eligible names only
factor_rules.missing_propagation: score is missing if any factor component is missing
factor_rules.smoothing: rolling mean with candidate smooth/min_smooth; current-day eligibility reapplied
factor_rules.tie_break: descending score, stable mergesort over lexical symbol order

evaluation.annual_excess: strategy total return minus SSE Composite total return for identical start/end dates
primary_order: maximize minimum across years of median annual excess
minimize standard deviation across yearly median excess
maximize mean CAGR across all starts
maximize minimum CAGR across all starts
maximize mean excess across all starts

development_gates.parameter_neighbor: at least one nearest same-family setting has positive worst-year median-excess improvement and candidate-to-neighbor deterioration is <= 0.02

evaluation.selection: among gated non-baseline candidates use primary_order lexicographically; if none pass, retain baseline

robustness.development_execution: historical fees, strict daily limits, T+1, lots, actions, 20-day mean-volume participation
